name: Skavio USDC Payment Verification & Proof MCP
author: Skavio LLC
description: 18 MCP tools for verifiable native Circle USDC payments with x402 v2 on Base and Solana: transaction verification, recipient/amount matching, blockchain payment evidence PDF, DNS/TLS verification and agent utilities. Public discovery is free; paid operations use wallet-signed x402. No custody. Evidence PDF is not a tax invoice. Standalone HTTP payment endpoints are separate and Base-only.
